y-m-26-03.title: Yini eshintshayo uma kwaziwa okwengeziwe ngama-diagonal?
y-m-26-03.topic: Izimfanelo zama-diagonal ezimo ezinezinhlangothi ezine, nokuhlonza izimo ezinezinhlangothi ezine
y-m-26-03.goal: Chaza, uxhumanisa nezimo, ukuthi isinqumo sokuthi isimo esinezinhlangothi ezine siyi-rectangle noma isikwele sishintsha kanjani lapho ulwazi ngama-diagonal lungezwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi, bese uqinisekisa ngezibonelo ozenzayo ukuthi ulwazi lokuqala kuphela alwanele.
y-m-26-03.material: Ama-diagonal amabili esimo esinezinhlangothi ezine ABCD yi-AC ne-BD. I-rectangle iyisimo esinezinhlangothi ezine esinama-engeli aso amane wonke aliqondile, i-rhombus iyisimo esinezinhlangothi ezine esinezinhlangothi zaso zonke ezine zinobude obufanayo, futhi isikwele siyisimo esinezinhlangothi ezine esinama-engeli aso amane wonke aliqondile futhi izinhlangothi zaso zonke ezine zinobude obufanayo. Cabanga ukuthi usuvele wazi ukuthi 'isimo esinezinhlangothi ezine esinama-diagonal amabili ahlukanisa ngamunye komunye phakathi yi-parallelogram'. Zonke izimo ezinezinhlangothi ezine zicatshangwa njenge-convex (izimo ezinezinhlangothi ezine ezingenayo ingxenye ehlehlele ngaphakathi).
y-m-26-03.thinking.0: Ukunquma ngolwazi oluyingxenye nokuvuselela lapho kufika ulwazi olusha
y-m-26-03.prereq.0: Incazelo ye-parallelogram, i-rectangle, i-rhombus, nesikwele, nezimfanelo zama-diagonal azo (ibanga leBanga 8)
y-m-26-03.prereq.1: Phakathi kwezimo ze-parallelogram, 'ama-diagonal amabili ahlukanisa ngamunye komunye phakathi'
y-m-26-03.prereq.2: Ibanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili epulanini lezixhumanisi
y-m-26-03.s.s1.prompt: Kusimo esinezinhlangothi ezine ABCD, ulwazi ngama-diagonal AC ne-BD lembulwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi. Isikhathi ngasinye, nquma 'ukuthi ingasho ukuthi iyi-rectangle yini'. (Akukho sithombe.)
y-m-26-03.s.s1.hint.0: Phinda ubhale ucezu ngalunye lolwazi njengesimfanelo 'sama-diagonal' esimo esinezinhlangothi ezine bese ulihlanganisa nezimfanelo zama-diagonal ze-rectangle, i-parallelogram, ne-rhombus.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ngemva kokuqoqa lonke ulwazi olwaziwa kuze kube manje, dweba ukuhlola ukuthi isimo esinezinhlangothi ezine esanelisa lonke lolo lwazi futhi singeyona i-rectangle siyenzeka yini.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ingabe isimo esinezinhlangothi ezine ABCD singasho ukuthi iyi-rectangle?
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Phakathi kwezimo ezinezinhlangothi ezine ezinama-diagonal alinganayo kukhona ezingezona ama-rectangle (isibonelo, i-trapezoid enemilenze emibili enobude obufanayo). Ngakho lolu lwazi lodwa alukwazi ukukuqinisekisa ukuthi iyi-rectangle. Bheka ulwazi olulandelayo bese uvuselela isinqumo sakho.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Iyi-rectangle. Ngoba i-rectangle inama-diagonal anobude obufanayo
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: 'Uma iyi-rectangle, ama-diagonal ayalingana' no-'uma ama-diagonal elingana, iyi-rectangle' kuya ezinhlangothini ezihlukile. Ukuthi okuphambene nakho kuyabamba kumele kusetshenzwe ngokwehlukana.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Awukwazi ukusho ngokuqiniseka ukuthi iyi-rectangle. Kubonakala sengathi kunezimo ezinezinhlangothi ezine ezingezona ama-rectangle noma ama-diagonal elingana
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ungadweba isimo esinezinhlangothi ezine esinobude bama-diagonal kuphela obulinganayo. Uma kukhona noma oyedwa, awukwazi ukusho ngokuqiniseka.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Akuyona i-rectangle. Ngoba akukho okusho ukuthi ahlukanisa ngamunye komunye phakathi
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ingase ibe i-rectangle. 'Akukho okusho ukuthi ahlukanisa ngamunye komunye phakathi' no-'awahlukanisi ngamunye komunye phakathi' kuhlukile.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ulwazi alwanele, ngakho asikwazi ukusho manje. Ingase ibe i-rectangle noma ingabi
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Ulwazi olusha: ama-diagonal amabili ahlukanisa ngamunye komunye phakathi. (Uma ukuhlangana kwama-diagonal kungu-O, khona AO = CO, BO = DO) Ulwazi lwangaphambilini (AC = BD) lusenjalo.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ingabe isimo esinezinhlangothi ezine ABCD manje singasho ukuthi iyi-rectangle?
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Uma ama-diagonal ahlukanisa ngamunye komunye phakathi, iyi-parallelogram. Ku-parallelogram ABCD, uma uqhathanisa unxantathu ABD nonxantathu DCA, AB = DC, AD = DA (evamile), BD = CA, ngakho bayafana (SSS), futhi ∠A = ∠D. Njengoba AB ∥ DC, ∠A + ∠D = 180°, ngakho ∠A = ∠D = 90°. Ngakho iyi-rectangle.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Singakwazi kuphela ukuthi iyi-parallelogram futhi singakazi ukuthi iyi-rectangle yini
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kulungile ukuthi iyi-parallelogram. Kodwa ungaqhubeka usebenzisa 'AC = BD' owawuyazi ekuqaleni. Yini eshintshayo uma usebenzisa izingcezu ezimbili zolwazi ndawonye?
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ku-rhombus udinga ulwazi lokuthi izinhlangothi ezine ziyalingana. Kuze kube manje akukho lwazi ngobude bezinhlangothi.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Unxande. Iyi-parallelogram lapho ama-diagonal amabili enobude obufanayo, ngakho ama-engeli amane ayalingana
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ukuze kube yisikwele, udinga olunye ulwazi lokuthi izinhlangothi ezine ziyalingana. Ukuhlukanisa ngesigamu kuphela kukutshela kuze kube i-parallelogram.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Okokugcina okufundiwe: ama-diagonal amabili ahlangana ngokuqondile. (AC ⊥ BD)
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Uma uhlanganisa nakho konke ulwazi lwangaphambilini, ligama liphi elinemininingwane eminingi kakhulu le-ABCD?
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Kunxande onama-diagonal ahlukanisa ngesigamu, uma ama-diagonal eqonde, i-rhombus (izinhlangothi ezine ezilinganayo). Bekuvele kunxande, ngakho wonke ama-engeli amane angama-engeli aqondile futhi zonke izinhlangothi ezine ziyalingana, ngakho isikwele. 'Unxande' wesinyathelo sangaphambilini usalungile, kodwa ulwazi olusha lwenze igama laba nemininingwane eminingi.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: I-rhombus nayo akulona igama eliphutha (ahlukanisa ngesigamu futhi aqonde). Kodwa uma uhlanganisa nolwazi lwesinyathelo sangaphambilini lokuthi kunxande, kukhona igama elinemininingwane eminingi.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ukusho unxande akuyona iphutha. Kodwa awusebenzisanga 'okuqondile' okutholwe kulesi sikhathi. Iyiphi i-parallelogram enama-diagonal aqondile?
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ufunde esinyathelweni sangaphambilini ukuthi kunxande. Ulwazi olusha alukwazi ukuphikisa isiphetho sangaphambilini.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.reflect: Cabanga ukuthi kungani ulwazi lokuqala (ubude obulinganayo bama-diagonal) lodwa lwalungakwazi ukukwenza uqiniseke ukuthi kunxande, ulwazi lwesibili lwengeze ini, nokuthi ulwazi lokugcina lushintshe noma lwengeze esiphethweni sangaphambilini.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.prompt: Ake siqinisekise ngokwethu ukuthi uma kwaziwa kuphela ulwazi lokuqala (AC = BD), kungenzeka ingabi yunxande. Beka u-A(0, 0) no-B(6, 0), bese wenza ama-quadrilateral ayi-2 ahlukile akhukhumeleyo ABCD anama-diagonal AC no-BD abude obufanayo futhi angama-parallelogram. (Ama-coordinate wamaphoyinti C no-D)
y-m-26-03.s.s2.hint.0: Misa iphoyinti C elilodwa bese ufuna lapho iphoyinti D lingaba khona elinebanga elisuka ku-B elilingana 'nebanga elisuka ku-A kuya ku-C'.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.hint.1: Dweba i-quadrilateral ngamaphoyinti owakhethile bese uhlola nokuthi izinhlangothi AB no-DC ziyafana yini nokuthi izinhlangothi AD no-BC ziyafana yini.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Ama-y-coordinate ka-C no-D kufanele abe makhulu kuno-0 (ngaphezu kuka-AB).
y-m-26-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Iyi-quadrilateral ekhukhumeleyo exhuma u-A, B, C, D ngokulandelana.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Uma uxhuma u-A, B, C, D ngokulandelana, iyi-quadrilateral engena ngaphakathi noma ephambana ngokwayo. Khetha amaphoyinti futhi ukuze ibe yi-quadrilateral enama-engeli amane onke ngaphansi kuka-180°.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Ubude be-AC no-BD abulingani. Bala ubude bama-diagonal amabili ngokwehlukana bese uqhathanisa.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Le quadrilateral iyi-parallelogram (kuhlanganise nonxande). Yenza isibonelo okungeyona i-parallelogram.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo, uma C(5, 3) no-D(1, 3), khona-ke AC² = 34 no-BD² = 25 + 9 = 34 (i-trapezoid enezinyawo ezimbili zobude obufanayo). Uma C(4, 3) no-D(3, 4), khona-ke AC = BD = 5 kodwa azikho izinhlangothi ezimbili ezifanayo. Zombili zinama-diagonal alinganayo kodwa azinunxande. Ngakho ungaqiniseki ngobude bama-diagonal kuphela.

y-m-26-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Izinombolo kumele zibe yizinombolo eziphelele ezingu-0 noma ngaphezulu.
y-m-26-06.title: Singawugcwalisa kanjani isikhala esizungeze iphoyinti ngokuxuba ama-polygon ajwayelekile?
y-m-26-06.topic: Ama-engeli angaphakathi ama-polygon ajwayelekile nama-engeli azungeze iphoyinti
y-m-26-06.goal: Xhumanisa i-engeli eyodwa engaphakathi ye-polygon ejwayelekile no-360° wama-engeli azungeze iphoyinti ukuthola inhlanganisela eziningana ezifanela umbandela, uchaze indlela yokuzithola ngaphandle kokushiya futhi nokuthi lo mbandela ukhuluma ngevertex eyodwa.
y-m-26-06.material: Indlu yokusebenzela amathayela ifuna ukusebenzisa amathayela onxantathu abalinganayo, izikwele nama-hexagon ajwayelekile. Wonke amathayela anobude bohlangothi obufanayo, ngakho angahlanganiswa ngokunembile uhlangothi nohlangothi. Kule msebenzi, ubala kuphela ukuthi, lapho amathayela amaningana eqoqiwe evertex eyodwa, ama-engeli azungeze leliphoyinti enza u-360° ngqo ngaphandle kwezikhala nangaphandle kokunqwabelana. Ukuthi lokhu kungamboza lonke indiza akuxoxwa.
y-m-26-06.thinking.1: Ukuklama indlela ehlelekile yokuthola konke ngaphandle kokushiya
y-m-26-06.prereq.0: Isamba sama-engeli angaphakathi e-polygon ne-engeli eyodwa engaphakathi ye-n-gon ejwayelekile (izinga lebanga lesi-8)
y-m-26-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha wonke ama-polygon ajwayelekile lapho kuphela izinhlobo ezimbalwa zalolo hlobo olulodwa zingagcwalisa ngokunembile isikhala esizungeze iphoyinti ngaphandle kwezikhala nangaphandle kokunqwabelana. (I-engeli eyodwa engaphakathi ye-n-gon ejwayelekile ingu-180° × (n − 2) ÷ n.)
y-m-26-06.s.s1.hint.0: Thola i-engeli eyodwa engaphakathi ye-polygon ejwayelekile ngayinye ngefomula bese uyibhala etafuleni.
y-m-26-06.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi i-engeli ngayinye engaphakathi kufanele ingezwe kangaki ukwenza u-360° ngqo, bese ubona ukuthi kukhona okusele yini.
y-m-26-06.s.s1.r.a: I-engeli eyodwa engaphakathi ingu-135°; hlola ukuthi kwenzekani uma wehlukanisa u-360° ngo-135°.
y-m-26-06.s.s1.r.d: I-engeli eyodwa engaphakathi ingu-108°; hlola ukuthi u-360° uhlukaniseka ngo-108° yini.
y-m-26-06.s.s1.explain: Ama-engeli azungeze iphoyinti angu-360°. Uma i-engeli eyodwa engaphakathi ingu-60°, 90° noma 120°, ngokuqondile ezingu-6, 4 noma 3 zayo zigcwalisa. 108° no-135° abahlukanisi u-360° ngokulinganayo. Kuvela izikhala noma kunqwabelana.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.prompt: Kulesi sikhathi ungaxuba onxantathu abalinganayo, izikwele nama-hexagon ajwayelekile. Yenza izinhlanganisela ezi-3 ezihlukile ezigcwalisa ngokunembile isikhala esizungeze iphoyinti ngaphandle kwezikhala nangaphandle kokunqwabelana, usebenzisa izinhlobo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu phakathi kwezikwele, onxantathu abalinganayo nama-hexagon ajwayelekile. (Inani lesimo ngasinye)
y-m-26-06.s.s2.hint.0: Zama amanani esimo ngasinye lapho ama-engeli angaphakathi engeza khona kuze kube ngu-360°. Kuhle ukunquma inani lohlobo olulodwa kuqala.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.hint.1: Bala isamba ngamanani owakhethile; uma singafinyeleli ku-360°, engeza izimo, futhi uma sidlula, shintsha izimo.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Isamba sama-engeli asiyona u-360°. Engeza u-60° kunxantathu olinganayo, u-90° esikweleni, no-120° ku-hexagon ejwayelekile izikhathi eziningi njengenani lesimo ngasinye.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Le yinhlanganisela esebenzisa uhlobo olulodwa kuphela. Xuba izinhlobo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.explain: Izinhlanganisela zezinombolo ezigcwele ezigcwalisa ngokunembile isikhala esizungeze iphoyinti ngezinhlobo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu zonxantathu abalinganayo, izikwele nama-hexagon ajwayelekile zingaba ezine kuphela (onxantathu abalinganayo, izikwele, ama-hexagon ajwayelekile) = (3, 2, 0), (1, 2, 1), (4, 0, 1), (2, 0, 2). Kodwa, isamba esingu-360° ephoyinteni elilodwa ngumbandela owodwa odingekayo kuphela, futhi ukuthi le ndlela ingamboza ngempela lonke indiza kudinga ukuhlola nezinye ama-vertex.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.because.prompt: Kufanele usesha kanjani ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi 'uzithole zonke' lezo zinhlanganisela? Bhala indlela ozoyisebenzisa.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Hlela izinhlanganisela osuzithole kuze kube manje etafuleni bese ubheka ukuthi uzithole ngokulandelana kuni.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Zama indlela yokumisa inani lama-hexagon ajwayelekile, njengo-0 no-1, bese ugcwalisa i-engeli esele.

y-m-26-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ukulandelana kucacile lapho umisa inani lesimo esisodwa bese usebenza okusele?
y-m-26-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubhale ukuthi ungazi kanjani ukuthi akusekho okunye uma wenza ngale ndlela?
y-m-26-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Uma ubeka inani lama-hexagon ajwayelekile ngokulandelana libe ngu-0, 1, 2, 3 bese usebenza ngamunye ukuthi ingosi esele ingagcwaliswa onxantathu abalinganayo abangu-60° nezikwele ezingu-90° yini, ungabathola ngaphandle kokuphuthelwa. Isamba singu-360°, ngakho akunakuba khona ama-hexagon ajwayelekile angaphezu kwa-3.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Uma uhlanganisa isamba esingu-360° ngamayunithi angu-30°, unxantathu olinganayo ungamayunithi ama-2, isikwele singamayunithi ama-3, futhi i-hexagon ejwayelekile ingamayunithi ama-4, ngakho (inani lonxantathu abalinganayo)×2+(inani lezikwele)×3+(inani lama-hexagon ajwayelekile)×4=12. Uma wenza ithebula bese ufaka izinombolo ngamunye, ungahlola wonke amacala.
y-m-26-06.s.s2.because.model.2: Misa inani lama-hexagon ajwayelekile ngalinye ngesikhathi njengo-0, 1, 2, 3, bese ngokulandelana usebenza ukuthi ingosi esele ingagcwaliswa onxantathu abajwayelekile nezikwele yini, bese uhlela wonke amacala ethebuleni.

y-m-26-01.title: Uma wazi izinhlangothi ezimbili ne-engeli eyodwa, unxantathu unqunyiwe ube munye?
y-m-26-01.topic: Izimo zokufana zonxantathu (izinhlangothi ezimbili ne-engeli eyodwa)
y-m-26-01.goal: Bonisa ngokwenza izibonelo eziphikisayo wena ukuthi isimangalo esithi 'izinhlangothi ezimbili ne-engeli eyodwa kuyalingana' singase singabambi kuye ngokuthi i-engeli ikuphi, bese unquma ukuthi yini enye edingekayo ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi onxantathu bafana.
y-m-26-01.material:
UJihu uthe, "Kunxantathu ABC nonxantathu DEF, uma AC=DF=10cm, BC=EF=6.5cm, futhi ∠A=∠D, khona onxantathu ababili bafana!"

Ukuze sikwazi ukukuhlola, ngibeke unxantathu ABC epulanini lezixhumanisi (isikwele esisodwa singu-1cm). A ungumsuka (0, 0) no-C ungu-(8, 6). Khona AC=10cm. B iphoyinti ku-x-axis, ngakwesokudla luka-A (i-x-coordinate yalo iyiphozithivu). ∠A i-engeli ekhiwe yingxenye AB ku-x-axis nengxenye AC. Singabeka unxantathu DEF ngendlela efanayo ukuze AC=DF no-∠A=∠D. Manje thola iphoyinti B elinoBC=6.5cm.
y-m-26-01.thinking.2: Ukunquma ukuthi ulwazi luyanela yini nokuthola ukuthi yini enye edingekayo
y-m-26-01.prereq.0: Ukufunda izimo zokufana zonxantathu SSS, SAS, ASA (ibanga leBanga 8)
y-m-26-01.prereq.1: Isikhundla samaphoyinti epulanini lezixhumanisi nebanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili
y-m-26-01.prereq.2: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinhlangothi ezintathu zikanxantathu ofanele (luyasiza lapho uhlola ubude)
y-m-26-01.s.s1.prompt: Uthini ngesimangalo sikaJihu? Khetha isinqumo esinengqondo kakhulu okwamanje.

y-m-26-01.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa izinhlu ezimbili bese uhlola ukuthi i-∠A iphakathi kwezinhlangothi ezimbili ezinikeziwe yini.
y-m-26-01.s.s1.o.a: Bayafana. Izinhlangothi ezimbili ne-engeli eyodwa kuyalingana, ngakho kuwela esimweni sokufana se-SAS
y-m-26-01.s.s1.r.a: I-SAS isetshenziswa kuphela lapho ama-engeli aphakathi kwezinhlangothi ezimbili elingana. Kule nkinga, i-∠A i-engeli ephakathi kweziphi ezimbili zezinhlangothi AC no-BC?
y-m-26-01.s.s1.o.b: Kungase kuhluke kuye ngokuthi i-engeli ikuphi. Dweba ukubona ukuthi ikhona yini enye unxantathu
y-m-26-01.s.s1.r.b: Lena indlela yokucabanga ecabanga nangesikhundla se-engeli futhi izama ukuhlola isinqumo ngokuhlola.
y-m-26-01.s.s1.o.c: Abafani. Izinhlangothi ezimbili ne-engeli eyodwa azikwazi ukunquma unxantathu nanini
y-m-26-01.s.s1.r.c: Inkinga yokujwayelekisa nge-'nanini'. Lapho kunikezwa izinhlangothi ezimbili ne-engeli ephakathi kwazo, unxantathu unqunyiwe (SAS). Cabanga ukuthi i-engeli ikuphi.
y-m-26-01.s.s1.o.d: Ngaphambi kokubona isithombe, angikwazi ukusho lutho ngokuthi bayafana noma abafani
y-m-26-01.s.s1.r.d: Izimo zinikeziwe njengezinombolo, ngakho ungazihlola noma ngaphandle kwesithombe. Zenze wena ngezixhumanisi noma ngesikhethi.

Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ubude bomugqa oqondile obungu-6cm noma 'hhayi i-engeli elungile' sekusebenza konxantathu bobabili, ngakho abakwazi ukubahlukanisa.

y-m-26-04.goal: Hlukanisa ngocezu lolwazi izimo lapho umbono wephoyinti eliphakathi usebenza khona, chaza ngokwenza isimo ukuthi kungani ukuhambisana kuphela kungenakunquma ubude, futhi ukhethe isimo sokubhekana nomehluko phakathi kwamanani wethiyori nawokukala.

Wonke amaphoyinti asemhlabathini ofanayo oyisicaba. Abafundi bathi 'BC = 60m'. Ezinyathelweni ezimbili zokuqala, cabanga ukuthi akukho phutha lokukala ngethephu.

Ngaphezu kwalokhu, uma ucezu ngalunye lolwazi olulandelayo lwengezwa 'ngalunye ngesikhathi', khetha zonke lapho ungaqiniseka khona ukuthi BC = 60m.

y-m-26-02.s.s1.hint.0: Emugqeni ngamunye, phawula ukuthi usebenzisa 'lokho okunikeziwe (ingcabango)' noma 'lokho okufanele kubonisiwe (isiphetho)'.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.hint.1: Hlunga izinto ezintathu emugqeni 3 ukuthi ngayinye iyingcabango, into etholwe emugqeni wangaphambilini, noma lokho okwakufanele kufakazelwe.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.line.1: Vumela M ibe liphoyinti eliphakathi lohlangothi BC bese uxhuma u-A no-M ngengxenye. Khona BM = CM.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.line.2: Kunxantathu ABM nonxantathu ACM, AB = AC, ∠B = ∠C (ama-engeli esisekelo sikanxantathu we-isosceles), futhi AM iyafana.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.line.3: Ngakho unxantathu ABM nonxantathu ACM bayafana.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.line.4: Konxantathu abafanayo ama-engeli ahambisanayo alingana ngosayizi, ngakho ∠B = ∠C.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.explain: Emugqeni 3, ∠B = ∠C kwabhalwa kakade sengathi liqiniso. Lokho yisiphetho ubufakazi obuhloselwe ukusibonisa. Ngenxa yalokho, ukufana emugqeni 4 akunasisekelo nakho (AB, ∠B, AM akuzona izinhlangothi ezimbili ne-engeli ephakathi), futhi umugqa 5 ugcina uphetha ngokuphinda lokho okwabhalwa ekuqaleni.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.prompt: Ufuna ukulungisa ubufakazi bukaSeohyeon. Lapho ushintsha indlela yokubonisa ukufana emugqeni 3, khetha zonke izindlela ezenza ubufakazi bube bulungile.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.hint.0: Ngendlela ngayinye, hlola ukuthi izinto ezintathu ezisetshenzisiwe zonke ziyingcabango, noma zilandela ngqo ekukhetheni kwephoyinti M.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi inesimo esihambisana nesimo sokufana (SSS, SAS, RHS). Hlola nokuthi kukhona yini ukhetho olusebenzisa isiphetho ∠B = ∠C.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.o.a: Thatha M njengonyawo lomugqa oqondile kusuka ku-A uye ku-BC bese uqhathanisa usebenzisa AB = AC, AM iyafana, ∠AMB = ∠AMC = 90°
y-m-26-02.s.s2.o.b: Bhala ∠B = ∠C bese wengeza ukuthi lokhu kulungile ngoba kubukeka kanjalo esithombeni
y-m-26-02.s.s2.r.b: Ukubukeka kanjalo esithombeni akusona isisekelo sobufakazi. Ubufakazi bubonisa isizathu sokuthi kungani kubukeka kanjalo.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.o.c: Thatha M njengephoyinti lapho i-bisector ye-∠A ihlangana khona no-BC bese uqhathanisa usebenzisa AB = AC, ∠BAM = ∠CAM, AM iyafana
y-m-26-02.s.s2.o.d: Bhala ukuthi onxantathu ABM no-ACM bayafana ngoba izindawo zabo ziyalingana, bese ubhala ukuthi ama-engeli ahambisanayo alingana
y-m-26-02.s.s2.r.d: Noma izindawo zilingana, izimo zingahluka (isibonelo, izikwele ezinde ezinobubanzi nobude obuhlukile). Indawo elinganayo kuphela ayenzi bafane.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.o.e: Thatha M njengephoyinti eliphakathi lika-BC bese uqhathanisa usebenzisa AB = AC, BM = CM, AM iyafana
y-m-26-02.s.s2.explain: e iyafana ngoba izinhlangothi ezintathu ziyalingana (SSS), c ngoba izinhlangothi ezimbili ne-engeli ephakathi zilingana (SAS), futhi a ngoba i-hypotenuse nolunye uhlangothi lukanxantathu ofanele kuyalingana (RHS). Akukho okubhala ∠B = ∠C ngaphambi kwesikhathi; zithola ∠B = ∠C ekufaneni.
y-m-26-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhala umlayezo wokutshela uSeohyeon. Sho ukuthi kungani ubufakazi bokuqala bungasho ukuthi bubonise 'ama-engeli esisekelo ayalingana', futhi ubhale ukuthi ungabulungisa kanjani ngenye yezindlela ezingenhla.
y-m-26-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale ngomusho owodwa ukuthi yikuphi kwezintathu ezibhalwe emugqeni 3 okufanele kufakazelwe.
y-m-26-02.s.s3.hint.1: Khetha indlela oyithandayo ezinkethweni ezingenhla, bhala phansi izinto ezintathu ezisebenzisayo, bese uhlola ukuthi ziyahambisana negama lesimo sokufana.
y-m-26-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ekubhaleni kwakho, ingabe kucacile 'ukuthi yini esivele isetshenzisiwe emugqeni muphi'?
y-m-26-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Endleleni oyilungisile, ingabe usebenzisa ∠B = ∠C njengesiphetho kuphela?
y-m-26-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Endleleni oyilungisile, ingabe zonke izinto ezintathu zesimo sokufana ziyinikeziwe, noma ziqhamuka ekukhetheni kwephoyinti M?
y-m-26-02.s.s3.model.0: Umugqa 3 usewusebenzisa ∠B = ∠C. Lokho yisiphetho okufanele sifakazelwe, ngakho akumele sisetshenziswe njengesisekelo. Ungakulungisa ngokusebenzisa ukufana kwe-SSS nengcabango AB = AC, BM = CM evela ngoba M iliphoyinti eliphakathi, ne-AM evamile.
y-m-26-02.s.s3.model.1: Ilethula ∠B = ∠C, okufanele kubonisiwe, njengesisekelo sokufana kuqala, ngakho ubufakazi buyazungeza. Uma uthatha iphoyinti M usebenzisa i-bisector ye-∠A bese usebenzisa ukufana kwe-SAS nge-AB = AC, ∠BAM = ∠CAM, AM evamile, awudingi ukucabanga ∠B = ∠C ngaphambilini.

y-m-26-05.title: Singakwazi yini ukwenza onxantathu abanendawo engu-12 ngezindlela eziningi?
y-m-26-05.goal: Qonda ukuthi umbandela wonxantathu abanesisekelo esifanayo ukuba nendawo efanayo ukuphakama, bese uthola amaphoyinti amaningana afeza izimo zendawo nosayizi we-engeli ngesikhathi esisodwa, uchaza isizathu.
y-m-26-05.material: Endizeni yama-coordinate, vumela ubude besikwele esisodwa bube ngu-1cm. Kunamaphoyinti A(0, 0) no-B(6, 0), futhi iphoyinti P liphezu kwe-x-axis. Ufuna iphoyinti P elinendawo yonxantathu ABP engu-12cm², futhi ama-coordinate ka-P ayizinombolo ezigcwele.
y-m-26-05.thinking.0: Ukuthola izixazululo eziningana ezifeza imikhawulo ngesikhathi esisodwa
y-m-26-05.thinking.1: Ukuqonda indawo (isimo) lapho amaphoyinti alele khona
y-m-26-05.prereq.0: Indawo yonxantathu = isisekelo × ukuphakama ÷ 2 (izinga lebanga lesi-5 lesikole samabanga aphansi)
y-m-26-05.prereq.1: Indawo yamaphoyinti endizeni yama-coordinate, nencazelo yama-engeli abukhali, aqondile nanhlangothi
y-m-26-05.prereq.2: Uma imigqa emibili ihambisana, ibanga phakathi kwayo liyafana (ibanga phakathi kwemigqa ehambisanayo)
y-m-26-05.s.s1.prompt: Endizeni yama-coordinate kunamaphoyinti A(0, 0) no-B(6, 0). Ufuna iphoyinti P libe ngaphezu kwe-x-axis futhi indawo yonxantathu ABP ibe ngu-12cm². Isimo sini ongasithola uma uqoqa onke amaphoyinti P anjalo? (Isikwele esisodwa singu-1cm)
y-m-26-05.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi ukuphakama kufanele kube phezulu kangakanani ukuze indawo ibe ngu-12 uma ubheka u-AB njengesisekelo sikanxantathu ABP.
y-m-26-05.s.s1.hint.1: Uma uhambisa u-P phezulu naphansi ngokuqonda ku-AB, cabanga ngezindlela ongahamba ngazo ugcine ukuphakama okufanayo.
y-m-26-05.s.s1.o.a: Amaphoyinti kumbuthano akhona ebangeni elifanayo no-A
y-m-26-05.s.s1.r.a: Noma amaphoyinti kumbuthano esebangeni elifanayo no-A, ibanga lawo kusuka ku-AB (ukuphakama) liyahluka.
y-m-26-05.s.s1.o.b: Iphoyinti elilodwa kuphela. Uma indawo isimiswe ku-12, P imiswa njengeyodwa
y-m-26-05.s.s1.r.b: Ukuba nesisekelo esifanayo nendawo efanayo kusho ukuba nokuphakama okufanayo. Ingabe liyiphoyinti elilodwa kuphela elinokuphakama okufanayo?
y-m-26-05.s.s1.o.c: Amaphoyinti kumugqa odlula maphakathi no-AB futhi oqonde ku-AB
y-m-26-05.s.s1.r.c: Amaphoyinti kulo mugqa anamabanga ahlukile no-AB, ngakho ukuphakama kuyahluka. Izindawo ziba ngahlukile komunye nomunye.
y-m-26-05.s.s1.o.d: Amaphoyinti kumugqa ohambisana no-AB futhi okude ngo-4cm no-AB
y-m-26-05.s.s1.explain: Isisekelo AB = 6cm siyafana, ngakho ukuze indawo ibe ngu-12cm², ukuphakama kufanele kube ngu-12 × 2 ÷ 6 = 4cm. Amaphoyinti ngokuphakama okungu-4cm kusuka ku-AB onke angamaphoyinti emgqeni ohambisana no-AB (y = 4).
y-m-26-05.s.s2.prompt: Thola amaphoyinti P ayi-3 ahlukile ukuze indawo yonxantathu ABP ibe ngu-12cm² futhi onke ama-engeli amathathu abukhali (ama-engeli amancane kuno-90°). Ama-coordinate ka-P ayizinombolo ezigcwele.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.hint.0: Phakathi kwamaphoyinti emgqeni owuthole esinyathelweni esedlule, shintsha ama-x-coordinate ngamunye ngamunye bese uhlola ukuthi ama-engeli abukhali yini.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.hint.1: Dweba ukuthi kwenzekani kuma-engeli emaphoyinteni A no-B uma x-coordinate incane kakhulu noma ikhulu kakhulu.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.ok.c1: P iphoyinti elinama-coordinate azizinombolo ezigcwele ngaphezu kwe-x-axis.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.fail.c1: P kufanele ibe ngaphezu kwe-x-axis (y>0) futhi ibe nama-coordinate azizinombolo ezigcwele.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Indawo yonxantathu ABP ayiyona u-12cm². Hlola futhi isisekelo AB nokuphakama.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Elilodwa kwama-engeli amathathu liyi-engeli eqondile noma enhlangothi. Hlola ama-engeli emaphoyinteni A, B no-P elilodwa ngelilodwa.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.explain: Uma P ingu-(1, 4), (2, 4), (3, 4), (4, 4), (5, 4), zonke zinokuphakama okungu-4cm ngakho indawo ingu-12. Uma x-coordinate ingu-0 noma 6, kunengeli eqondile ku-A noma ku-B, futhi ngaphandle kwalokho inhlangothi. Ngakho lawa amahlanu kuphela amaphoyinti ane-coordinate ezigcwele. Iphoyinti (3, 4) linika unxantathu onezinhlangothi ezimbili ezilinganayo, futhi osele bangonxantathu bezimo ezahlukene.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Qhathanisa amaphoyinti owathole. Chaza ukuthi kungani izindawo ziyafana noma isimo sikanxantathu sihlukile ephoyinteni ngalinye, nokuthi umbandela we-engeli ebukhali ukhawulele kanjani izindawo zamaphoyinti.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Qhathanisa ama-y-coordinate amaphoyinti owathole bese usho ukuthi alele kumugqa muni.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Dweba ukuthi ama-engeli emaphoyinteni A no-B angamadigri amangaki uma x-coordinate ka-P ingu-0 nalapho ingu-6.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uchaze ukuthi kungani izindawo ziyafana ngokuthi 'isisekelo siyafana nokuphakama kuyafana nakho'?
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uchaze ngama-engeli ukuthi kungani akusebenzi uma x-coordinate ingu-0, 6, noma ingaphandle?
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Amaphoyinti asemgqeni ohambisana no-AB, ngakho ubheka u-AB njengesisekelo, ukuphakama konke kuyafana, 4, nesisekelo siyafana, 6, ngakho izindawo zonke zingu-12. Uma x-coordinate ingu-0 noma 6, kunengeli eqondile ku-A noma ku-B, futhi uma incane kuno-0 noma inkulu kuno-6 iyinhlangothi, ngakho kusebenza kuphela u-1 kuya ku-5.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Isisekelo AB singu-6 futhi ukuphakama kuyafana, 4, ngakho noma izimo zihlukile izindawo ziyafana. Ama-engeli kufanele abukhali, ngakho P akumele ibe ngqo ngaphezu kuka-A noma B noma ngaphandle kwawo, futhi x-coordinate kufanele ibe phakathi kuka-0 no-6.
